parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses other components such as drawers, shelves, and doors.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other movable components.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of solid wood, located at the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for storing small items and can be pulled out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support panel of the cabinet, made of MDF for stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures balance on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the front opening of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the internal storage space and conceals the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.
